continuity: Use the supplied Kiran portrait as the identity reference in every human scene.
Start each film from its corresponding approved GPT Image keyframe.
A small red field notebook travels with Kiran through every city; it is the subtle continuity object, never a product shot.
Every city has a distinct physical action and its own motivated visual handoff to the flight map.
Keep text, dates, logos, and route graphics out of generated media; the webpage renders them as HTML and SVG.
Do not recreate a handoff frame from text after video generation; extract the actual final frame when continuity is required.

creativeDirection.principle: The captions state only city, dates, role, and institution. Personality and narrative live in the films.
creativeDirection.recurringObject: A worn red field notebook that becomes fuller and more annotated as the journey advances.
creativeDirection.transitionLanguage: Each city film ends on a stable elevated composition with a strong geographic line. The webpage contracts that real scene into the exact city node, then launches an SVG aircraft along a distance-scaled route tangent.
creativeDirection.tone: Photorealistic, playful in observation rather than comedic, candid rather than posed, one continuous remembered journey.
